correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 a Rule-57 site update holds the center exactly for neighbors (0,1), otherwise it complements; hence each update is involutive and a complete sweep is bijective. If F(x)=y and F(y)=x, any unchanged bit would require its adjacent bits unchanged in both sweeps; cyclic connectivity would make all bits unchanged, contradicting impossibility of a fixed point. Thus y=1-x. Interior toggles give x_{i+2}=1-x_i for 0<=i<=n-3, while the two scan-seam constraints give x_{n-1}=x_1 and x_{n-2}=x_0. The four-term recurrence and both boundary equations have four solutions precisely for n=2 mod4, none otherwise; these make two 2-orbits under complement. Independently written truth-table exhaustive search reproduced exact second-iterate fixed sets for every n=3..15; finite enumeration is corroboration, the boundary argument proves all n.
